domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The domain the test should be performed in.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The subject of this filter test.

test.title: Test
test.description: The name of the test to apply.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value being compared with the test.

filters.description: Conditions that must be met for this preset to be applied.

kick_speed_scale.title: Kick Speed Scale
kick_speed_scale.description: Multiplier applied to the pushing entity's movement speed to determine kick force. Only used when push_mode is "ball".

max_distance.title: Max Distance
max_distance.description: Maximum horizontal distance between the center of the pushed entity and the collision of the pushing entity for push forces to be applied. Entities further apart than this will not push each other.

max_kick_speed.title: Max Kick Speed
max_kick_speed.description: Maximum speed the entity can be pushed back at, regardless of how fast the pushing entity is moving. Only used when push_mode is "ball".

min_distance.title: Min Distance
min_distance.description: Minimum horizontal distance between the centers of the two entities for push forces to be applied. Entities closer than this will not push each other.

min_kick_speed.title: Min Kick Speed
min_kick_speed.description: Minimum speed the the entity will be pushed back at, regardless of how slowly the pushing entity is moving. Only used when push_mode is "ball".

play_sound.title: Play Sound
play_sound.description: If the "pushed_by_player" sound should be played when the entity is pushed by any other entity (despite the sound name).

play_sound_cooldown_in_seconds.title: Play Sound Cooldown In Seconds
play_sound_cooldown_in_seconds.description: Cooldown in seconds between sounds. A lower number results in more sounds.

play_sound_impulse_threshold.title: Play Sound Impulse Threshold
play_sound_impulse_threshold.description: Minimum change of velocity needed to trigger the push sound. A lower value means higher sensitivity.

push_mode.title: PushMode
push_mode.description:
Defines the type of push vector calculation applied to the entity:
- "none": The entity cannot be pushed.
- "default": Standard push calculations used by most entities.
- "legacy_boat": Legacy push calculations historically used by boats. Includes dampened forces and sneak-based cancellation.
- "legacy_minecart": Legacy push calculations historically used by minecarts. Includes alignment-based collision handling and velocity averaging.- "ball": Push calculation resulting in a behavior similar to kicking a ball. The entity is propelled in the direction of the pusher’s movement, with force scaled by their speed.

push_scale_other.title: Push Scale Other
push_scale_other.description: Scales how much push force this entity applies to the other entity when colliding. A value of 1.0 applies full force, 0.5 applies half.

push_scale_self.title: Push Scale Self
push_scale_self.description: Scales how much this entity pushes itself away when colliding with another entity. A value of 1.0 applies full force, 0.5 applies half.

require_collision_overlap.title: Require Collision Overlap
require_collision_overlap.description: When true, entities will not push each other unless their collision boxes overlap.

strength_multiplier.title: Strength Multiplier
strength_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the push strength. Higher values result in stronger pushes.

vertical_kick_multiplier.title: Vertical Kick Multiplier
vertical_kick_multiplier.description: Multiplier for the upward force applied when the entity is pushed while on the ground. A value of 0 keeps the entity flat. Only used when push_mode is "ball".
